text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated error rate and timeout spike on /v1/generate (runway-model-route). p95 jumped from ~150ms -> ~1.2s, p99 ~2.7s. 5xx rate ~11% in last 5m. SLO crossing threshold. Auto-page triggered.

maria.k: i'm seeing the alert. paging @sam.t and @jake.s — deploy finished ~18:05 UTC. anyone oncall? :rotating_light:

sam.t: ack. i'm on it, pulling logs and traces.

jake.s: i'll grab distributed traces and infra metrics. initial glance shows mem pressure on a subset of workers.

sam.t: logs snippet:
```
504 upstream timeout -> worker-12
runtime/latency: p95 1.18s p99 2.74s
kvcache/evictions_per_s: 220
```
sam.t: kubectl showing multiple restarts in us-east-1 for pods with release=redwood-runtime-canary.

maria.k: any customer impact numbers? which tenants?

lucy.p: support: top impacted customers: AcmeCorp (high error rate, external timeouts), ZenDeskX (elevated), BetaApps (sporadic). CS alerted for AcmeCorp.

sam.t: my hypothesis: new aggregator kernel in v2026.3.1 + high kv-cache churn causing stalls and upstream timeouts. Correlates with canary rollout window.

sam.t: mitigation plan proposal: (1) toggle off aggregator flag on canaries (--use-agg-kernel=false), (2) shift 50% traffic to stable pool in us-west-2, (3) if no improvement in 3m perform immediate rollback to v2026.2.9.

maria.k: do it. prioritize rollback if no improvement.

sam.t: toggling flag on canary nodes now...

sam.t: status: flag toggle applied to 6/8 canary nodes; partial improvement on those nodes (p95 ~700ms) but global p95 still ~980ms. initiating traffic shift.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Traffic shift: routing 50% runway-model-route -> stable-us-west-2 initiated by sam.t at 2620009920.

sam.t: shift applied. monitoring...

maria.k: quick check — are we seeing any cascade to downstream gateways? ops reported some 502's?

jake.s: downstream gateway errors spike coincident with eviction bursts. traces show long tail stalls waiting on kv lookups.

sam.t: no full recovery after toggle+shift. initiating rollback: `orchctl rollback --release v2026.2.9 --target runway-model-route`

deploy-bot: rollback started by sam.t at 2620009955.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 2620010150. traffic now 100% on v2026.2.9.

jake.s: post-rollback metrics (2m after): p95 160ms, p99 340ms, 5xx down to 1.3%. eviction rate returned to baseline.

maria.k: good recovery. marking mitigated. handoff and next steps: sam.t to own postmortem/rca, lucy.p to coordinate customer follow-ups.

sam.t: will open incident ticket with timeline, logs, heap profiles, eviction graphs, and config diff for v2026.3.1 -> v2026.2.9. tentative RCA: aggregator kernel regression under KV cache churn — amplifies latency tail.

lucy.p: i'll prepare support templates and send initial notice to AcmeCorp + ZenDeskX. will include ETA for postmortem.

maria.k: handoff: sam.t -> jake.s for deeper infra forensics (tomorrow oncall). Please include mitigation playbook: auto-fallback to stable pool when p95 > 1s for >2m, and circuit to disable kernel flag in rollout.

sam.t: action items added: [1] add alert for kv eviction spike (evictions/s > 150), [2] implement auto-route-fallback on p95 breach, [3] revert kernel flag rollout and gate behind perf-test harness.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated and closed (auto) at 2620013450. Severity recorded: Sev2. SLA impact: yes — brief SLO breach captured.

maria.k: thanks everyone. i'll update the incident board and schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow. any final notes?

sam.t: note — we should run extended load tests with kv churn scenarios before next kernel merge.

lucy.p: noted, i'll include that in customer-facing postmortem.

maria.k: closing thread, follow-ups in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
